_doc: Keywords per lesson section, used by `course_sources.py scope --suggest` to look for a section's topic in a course's documents (syllabus text, reading list, past exams). Hebrew keywords are matched after stripping one-letter prefixes (ה ו ב ל ש מ כ). Add an entry whenever a lesson section is added. A lesson's "_heading" keywords are the broader syllabus headings that cover it (a hit there → sections without their own hit become 'likely'). Keywords that are a syllabus heading itself mean the section is part of that topic BY DEFINITION (→ core).
